newsitem.title: USA: Consumers sees Mich. nuke fully back Friday.
newsitem.headline: Consumers sees Mich. nuke fully back Friday.

text.p: Consumers Energy said Thursday its 780 megawatt Palisades nuclear power plant would reach full output Friday after being restarted late yesterday.
"Give it another day. It's at 53 percent (power). We're escalating four to five percent per hour," said a company spokesman when asked about the plant's status.
Consumers shut the plant in South Haven, Mich., early Monday after discovery of a hydrogen leak on the unit's main generator, where hydrogen is used as a cooling agent.
A week ago, it was producing at about 50 percent capacity due to a vibration in the isophase bus.
Consumers Energy is a subsidiary of CMS Energy Corp.
